_comment: COMMITTED, READ-ONLY enforcement floor for action-guard (VF-05). This file is git-TRACKED and is the source of truth for the deny tier. The agent-writable state/config.json (gitignored) may only RAISE strictness (promote_to_ask / promote_to_deny); it can NEVER remove an id from this deny list nor lower a tier. The hook reads the deny tier from THIS file, not from state/. Do not move this under state/.
notes: deny = catastrophic/irreversible ONLY: filesystem/system destruction, backdoors/reverse shells, remote-exec pipes (curl|bash, base64 -d|bash), whole-table/collection/database/keyspace data wipes, overwrite of /etc/{passwd,shadow,sudoers,...}, shutdown/reboot, kill -9 -1. The ask tier (costly-but-legitimate infra ops) lives in shared/patterns/dangerous-ops.json as the per-rule enforcement field; the deny floor here overrides that field upward and cannot be lowered by config.
